title: KestrelCare Facility Rate Card: Diagnostic Hourly Rate
content:
| Facility type on the decision | Diagnostic hourly rate on a KestrelCare repair order |
|---|---|
| franchised dealer | the plan's labor rate cap plus the dealer diagnostic premium of 20.00 USD |
| Kestrel network facility | the network diagnostic rate of 95.00 USD |
| any other facility (independent licensed repair shop) | the plan's labor rate cap |

**Rule.** On a KestrelCare Vehicle Service Contracts repair order, the diagnostic hourly rate follows the facility type on the decision: a franchised dealer is paid the plan's labor rate cap plus the dealer diagnostic premium; a Kestrel network facility is paid the network diagnostic rate; any other facility is paid the plan's labor rate cap.

The facility type is the one on the plan's most recent approved claim decision entry; the labor rate cap is that of the plan's coverage level.

*Hypothetical:* with a labor rate cap of 160.00, a franchised dealer is paid 180.00 per diagnostic hour, a Kestrel network facility 95.00 and an independent licensed repair shop 160.00.
